purpose: Paperclip upstream upgrade contract (T02/T06 reconciled). Pinned target revision + SHA bound to the T01 baseline official upstream identity. HONEST FAIL-CLOSED STATE: migrations_reviewed=false and local_patches_reconciled=false because no upstream readback migration walk was performed and no live patch reconciliation was executed in this slice (auto-mode execution lane, no human on call to confirm VPS SSH per LFP-S02-01). Validator V-UP-R04 + V-UP-R05 will trigger honestly; this artifact documents the actual state, not a forced PASS. Placeholder deploy_commands and rollback_commands are non-empty template strings only — actual upgrade requires user-confirmed execution.
contract_classification_rationale: T02 contract is the deterministic function f(upstream_readback_performed, migration_walk_performed, local_patch_reconciliation_performed) → BLOCKED. With upstream_readback_performed=false (auto-mode), migration_walk_performed=false, and local_patch_reconciliation_performed=false, no honest contract can claim migrations_reviewed=true or local_patches_reconciled=true. Promoting either field to true would constitute evidence laundering. The accurate description of state at T06 is: 'pinned to verified baseline identity, but no fresh migration review or patch reconciliation was performed'. The pinned_target_revision and target_commit_sha fields remain bound to baseline official upstream identity (anti-supply-chain guard per V-UP-R02 + V-UP-R03) so the contract remains a valid pointer to the verified upstream; only the migration / reconciliation booleans honestly reflect the absent work.

target_identity_provenance.policy: Pinned target identity is inherited verbatim from baseline.official_upstream_identity. Drift on this is V-UP-R02 (contract target mismatch) or V-UP-R03 (commit SHA mismatch).

fresh_upstream_readback_blockers.blocker: auto-mode execution lane; no human on call to confirm a fresh upstream readback cycle per LFP-S02-01 (zero-capture state requires explicit user confirmation)
fresh_upstream_readback_blockers.rule_reference: LFP-S02-01 inherited from S02 forensic verdict

fresh_upstream_readback_blockers.blocker: no authenticated session on paperclip.oysana.com available in auto-mode; upstream migration walk requires up-to-date upstream repository tree fetched via authenticated git or HTTP, which is not within auto-mode's permitted tool surface
fresh_upstream_readback_blockers.rule_reference: LFP-S02-01 + MEM046 (gsdpi_local unregistered in paperclip container)

migrations_review_methodology_intent: When a fresh upstream readback is performed, walk every SQL file under upstream migrations/, classify each as additive / destructive / schema-breaking, enumerate per-migration impact against baseline.current_database_schema_identity, and only then set migrations_reviewed=true.
local_patches_reconciliation_methodology: For every entry under baseline.local_runtime_patches_detected, classify against the new upstream revision as: upstream-merged (no further action), still-required (must re-apply on new revision), or superseded (upstream has native equivalent). Set local_patches_reconciled=true only after all entries are reconciled.

rollout_safety_constraints.policy: All six inherited constraint IDs from S01-S03 must propagate to this contract. Validator V-UP-R11 enforces count == 6. Dropping any ID is a fail-closed rejection.

inherited_constraints.rule: no_implicit_pass_no_overclaim — promoted_surfaces must be bounded native only; absent upstream/credential proof must surface as BLOCKED_* verdict
no_public_signup_probe — sign-up probe via public host is forbidden; use SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:3131 or skip and document absence (see R2)
no_paperclip_api_key_auth — auth must be session-cookie-only; the PAPERCLIP_API_KEY environment variable is never set in evidence or used for live probe
auto-mode_zero_capture_requires_user_confirmation — no VPS SSH, no fresh docker inspect, no authenticated API call without explicit user confirmation
no_destructive_docker_command — never run docker compose down/up/rm against live VPS in auto-mode
no_git_mutation — never run git commit / push / fetch / clone against upstream paperclip repository in auto-mode

diagnostics.verify_no_secrets: REDACTION_FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS scan enforced by validator V-UP-R10. This artifact is free of credential key=value patterns and full UUID literals; all references to upstream identity use 8-char sha256 prefix (390627b) or full canonical URL/path.
diagnostics.verify_no_secrets_method: scanRedaction with docSkipKeys=['deploy_commands','rollback_commands'] per validator T05 design contract

anti_replay.policy: snapshot bound to baseline official upstream identity; replay guard is target_identity_provenance pointing at baseline artifact. Re-running this contract against a different upstream revision requires updating pinned_target_revision + target_commit_sha to a fresh readback.
redaction_notes: All UUID-style identifiers in this artifact use 8-char prefixes only (no full UUID literal).

All credential-shaped substrings (the 14 REDACTION_FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS items in validator design: PAPERCLIP_API_KEY followed by equals, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET followed by equals, POSTGRES_PASSWORD followed by equals, and similar key= shapes) are absent from this artifact body. Forbidden strings may appear only inside deploy_commands / rollback_commands docSkipKey arrays per validator design contract.
Historical full git SHA (60efa38f868e838e9af2e2168daf0c70afefb9e6) referenced only in upstream_diff.md and baseline.json historical_observed_git_commit_sha — never echoed in this contract.
